title: The week opens on a whole hour and every calendar has a readable colour
steps: Look at the top of the Week grid, today's earlier events and an unanswered invitation
Switch Settings › Appearance to Dark, Midnight and the System themes and look again
expected: The grid opens on a whole hour with no event cut at the top. Each calendar has its own colour: a tinted block with a coloured bar and readable text. Past events are paler, unanswered invitations have a dashed outline and declined ones are struck through, in every theme.
